fixtures.name: golden-smallest
fixtures.description: Minimum-legal non-empty pack: 1 tile at (0,0,0), 8×8 px, WebMercator/Quadtree/XYZ, no extension sections.

fixtures.name: golden-grid
fixtures.description: Regular 4×4 grid at z=2 (16 tiles, 8×8 px each), full WebMercator world coverage; no extension sections.

fixtures.name: golden-empty-quadtree
fixtures.description: Metadata-only Quadtree pack (§ 8.6): tile_count = 0, no tile blob, no extension sections. The smallest legal Quadtree pack at 296 bytes.

fixtures.name: golden-singleimage-affn
fixtures.description: (LocalLinear, SingleImage) pack with 1 tile at (0,0,0), 8×8 px, AFFN extension placing the image over the 2°×2° square at origin. The only v1 path that exercises § 7.3 AFFN encoding and § 4.9 LocalLinear bbox derivation.

fixtures.name: neg-02-bad-magic
fixtures.description: Pack with first byte zeroed (\x00AWT); all other fields valid; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: first 4 bytes MUST be ASCII "RAWT" (0x52 0x41 0x57 0x54)

fixtures.mutation: header[0] zeroed (magic RAWT → \x00AWT); CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-03-major-2
fixtures.description: Pack with format_version_major = 2; all other fields valid; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: format_version_major MUST be 1 in v1

fixtures.mutation: header[4] (format_version_major) 1 → 2; CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-05-uuid-zero
fixtures.description: Pack with pack_uuid = 0 (the all-zero reserved sentinel); all other fields valid; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: pack_uuid MUST NOT be all-zero (§ 4.3 reserves the value)

fixtures.mutation: header[8..24] (pack_uuid) sha256-derived → all-zero (16 zero bytes); CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-06-parent-nonzero
fixtures.description: Pack with parent_uuid[0] = 1 (any non-zero value is reserved for future use in v1); CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: parent_uuid MUST be all-zero in v1 (§ 4.5 reserves the field for future use)

fixtures.mutation: header[40] (parent_uuid byte 0) 0 → 1; CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-07a-pixfmt-0
fixtures.description: Pack with pixel_format = 0 (reserved); all other fields valid; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: any unknown pixel_format, projection, tile_addressing_scheme, tile_axis_convention, or compression byte MUST be rejected (§ 8)

fixtures.mutation: pixel_format byte (file offset 56) 1 → 0 (reserved); CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-07b-pixfmt-2
fixtures.description: Pack with pixel_format = 2 (reserved, L4 indexed); all other fields valid; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: any unknown pixel_format, projection, tile_addressing_scheme, tile_axis_convention, or compression byte MUST be rejected (§ 8)

fixtures.mutation: pixel_format byte (file offset 56) 1 → 2 (reserved, L4 indexed); CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-07c-proj-0
fixtures.description: Pack with projection = 0 (reserved); all other fields valid; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: any unknown pixel_format, projection, tile_addressing_scheme, tile_axis_convention, or compression byte MUST be rejected (§ 8)

fixtures.mutation: projection byte (file offset 57) 1 → 0 (reserved); CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-07d-proj-2
fixtures.description: Pack with projection = 2 (reserved, equirectangular); all other fields valid; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: any unknown pixel_format, projection, tile_addressing_scheme, tile_axis_convention, or compression byte MUST be rejected (§ 8)

fixtures.mutation: projection byte (file offset 57) 1 → 2 (reserved, equirectangular); CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-07e-addr-0
fixtures.description: Pack with tile_addressing_scheme = 0 (reserved); all other fields valid; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: any unknown pixel_format, projection, tile_addressing_scheme, tile_axis_convention, or compression byte MUST be rejected (§ 8)

fixtures.mutation: tile_addressing_scheme byte (file offset 58) 1 → 0 (reserved); CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-07f-axis-0
fixtures.description: Pack with tile_axis_convention = 0 (reserved); all other fields valid; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: any unknown pixel_format, projection, tile_addressing_scheme, tile_axis_convention, or compression byte MUST be rejected (§ 8)

fixtures.mutation: tile_axis_convention byte (file offset 59) 1 → 0 (reserved); CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-07g-comp-1
fixtures.description: Pack with compression = 1 (reserved, LZ4); all other fields valid; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: any unknown pixel_format, projection, tile_addressing_scheme, tile_axis_convention, or compression byte MUST be rejected (§ 8)

fixtures.mutation: compression byte (file offset 293) 0 → 1 (reserved, LZ4); CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-09-tiledim-zero
fixtures.description: Pack with tile_dim_px = 0; § 4.7 requires non-zero. Built on the metadata-only base so § 11 #16 (length = tile_dim²) cannot also fire. CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: tile_dim_px MUST be non-zero (§ 4.7)

fixtures.mutation: header[60..62] (tile_dim_px, u16 LE) 8 → 0; CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-10a-zmax-24
fixtures.description: Pack with zoom_max = 24 (§ 4.8 requires zoom_max < 24, the size of zoom_offsets[24]); CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: zoom_max MUST be < 24 and zoom_min MUST be ≤ zoom_max (§ 4.8)

fixtures.mutation: header[63] (zoom_max) 0 → 24; CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-10b-zmin-gt-zmax
fixtures.description: Pack with zoom_min = 1 and zoom_max = 0 (inverted). Built on the metadata-only base so § 11 #15 (entry z out of [zmin, zmax]) cannot also fire. CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: zoom_max MUST be < 24 and zoom_min MUST be ≤ zoom_max (§ 4.8)

fixtures.mutation: header[62] (zoom_min) 0 → 1; header[63] (zoom_max) stays at 0; CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-11a-lon-overflow
fixtures.description: Pack with bbox.max_lon = +180_000_001, one µ° past the +180_000_000 limit; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: bbox values MUST lie within [-180M, +180M] µ° (lon) / [-90M, +90M] µ° (lat) and satisfy min ≤ max (§ 4.9)

fixtures.mutation: header[72..76] (bbox.max_lon) 180_000_000 → 180_000_001 (out of [-180M, +180M] µ° range); CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-11b-lat-overflow
fixtures.description: Pack with bbox.min_lat = -90_000_001, one µ° past the -90_000_000 limit; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: bbox values MUST lie within [-180M, +180M] µ° (lon) / [-90M, +90M] µ° (lat) and satisfy min ≤ max (§ 4.9)

fixtures.mutation: header[68..72] (bbox.min_lat) -85_051_129 → -90_000_001 (out of [-90M, +90M] µ° range); CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-11c-lon-inverted
fixtures.description: Pack with bbox lon endpoints swapped (min_lon > max_lon); both values still in range, so inversion is the lone violation; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: bbox values MUST lie within [-180M, +180M] µ° (lon) / [-90M, +90M] µ° (lat) and satisfy min ≤ max (§ 4.9)

fixtures.mutation: header[64..68] (bbox.min_lon) and header[72..76] (bbox.max_lon) swapped: min_lon -180_000_000 → +180_000_000, max_lon +180_000_000 → -180_000_000; CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-11d-lat-inverted
fixtures.description: Pack with bbox lat endpoints swapped (min_lat > max_lat); both values still in range, so inversion is the lone violation; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: bbox values MUST lie within [-180M, +180M] µ° (lon) / [-90M, +90M] µ° (lat) and satisfy min ≤ max (§ 4.9)

fixtures.mutation: header[68..72] (bbox.min_lat) and header[76..80] (bbox.max_lat) swapped: min_lat -85_051_129 → +85_051_129, max_lat +85_051_129 → -85_051_129; CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-12a-flags-nonzero
fixtures.description: Pack whose lone tile-index entry has flags = 1; v1 requires flags = 0; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: tile-index entry flags (byte 2) and reserved (byte 3) MUST be 0 in v1 (§ 5.2)

fixtures.mutation: file[294] (tile-index entry 0 byte 2, flags) 0 → 1; CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-12b-reserved-nonzero
fixtures.description: Pack whose lone tile-index entry has reserved = 1; v1 requires reserved = 0; CRC recomputed.

expected_reject_rule.summary: tile-index entry flags (byte 2) and reserved (byte 3) MUST be 0 in v1 (§ 5.2)

fixtures.mutation: file[295] (tile-index entry 0 byte 3, reserved) 0 → 1; CRC recomputed.

fixtures.name: neg-24-crc-flipped
fixtures.description: Pack with footer u32 XOR'd with 0x0000_0001 (LSB of CRC flipped). Body bytes identical to golden-smallest.

expected_reject_rule.summary: CRC-32/ISO-HDLC footer MUST match a fresh computation over bytes [0, file_size − 4) (§ 10)

fixtures.mutation: file[-4] (CRC footer byte 0, LSB) XOR 0x01; body bytes unchanged.

fixtures.name: neg-25-index-offset-296
fixtures.description: Pack with index_offset = 296 instead of the v1.0-required 292.

expected_reject_rule.summary: index_offset must equal 292 in v1.0

fixtures.mutation: index_offset 292 → 296; tile-index region shifted right by 4 zero bytes; zoom_offsets[0].offset, entry.offset, extensions_offset updated; CRC recomputed.
